scope: Development failures corrected before final acceptance; no production GPU/weights involved

items.error: Alembic naming convention prefixed an already-prefixed check constraint name
items.fix: Use op.f for the existing constraint; rerun with a fresh verified backup

items.error: Windows DirEntry.stat reports st_nlink=0, ordinary files were rejected
items.fix: Use lstat for actual file link count; keep pointer and hardlink rejection

items.error: Synthetic idempotency token was shorter than the existing 16-character minimum
items.fix: Use a valid test token; retain API validation

items.error: Dialog close accessible name did not match the drawer close button
items.fix: Target the drawer close button; rerun all ten groups

items.stage: closeout review of source changes during a slow read
items.error: Valid issued-snapshot reads could be rejected after catalog expiry, revision change or catalog removal, leaving the management queue running
items.fix: Accept validated same-boot, in-lease observations of the issued snapshot; keep creator/registration current-source and age gates; allow the next command

items.error: A completed same-file check reused its old idempotency key and could replay expired evidence
items.fix: Clear the create intent only after receiving an operation id; preserve unknown-result retries; new explicit reads obtain a fresh key
